blocks.orig: The Baobab Tented Camp is located in a remote area of the Tarangire National Park. Laid out in a row in between the baobab and acacia trees with nothing else around for miles on end, this camp offers ten safari tents, including one family tent, with private terraces and bathrooms. A restaurant and bar are available for meals and drinks, while free WiFi still connects you to the outside world. Here you enjoy an extraordinary amount of seclusion and remoteness, while animals come close and lions roar into the sunset.
blocks.html: In a remote part of Tarangire National Park lies The Baobab Tented Camp. Its ten safari tents, one of them a family tent, stand in a row among baobab and acacia trees, with nothing else around for miles, and each has a private terrace and bathroom. There is a restaurant and bar for meals and drinks, and free WiFi keeps you in touch with the outside world. You enjoy remarkable seclusion and remoteness here, while animals come close by and lions roar as the sun goes down.
